_doc: The 10 mm slot of the 40 and 45 mm series as European sellers stock it ("B-type", made to match Bosch Rexroth's), for unbranded stock. One named seller prints the opening and its tolerance (Dold Mechatronik: 10,0 +0,4 mm, on 40x40L and 45x45L alike); no seller's page read so far dimensions the lip, the cavity or the depth, so those are Rexroth's figures for the 40 mm series, which the 45 mm heavy sections share (the 45 mm light sections are 14.5 deep: slot-10-bosch-45l). Every figure is community: measure the bar you have. The drawn slot leaves out the steps that thin each lip toward the opening.
name: slot-10

opening.rule: Between the lips: "Groove dimension 10,0 + 0,4 mm" at Dold. Unbranded stock differs from seller to seller: measure yours
opening.source: Dold Mechatronik, Aluminum Profile Complete Catalog, version 2026_01_29, pages 55 (40x40L B-Type Groove 10) and 58 (45x45L B-Type Groove 10)

lip_thickness.rule: From the face to the lip's underside where it meets the cavity's wall: Rexroth's figure. Unbranded stock differs from seller to seller: measure yours
lip_thickness.source: slot-10-bosch rule set (Bosch Rexroth MGE 14.0, page 2-23): the slot B-type stock is sold to match; not printed by an unbranded seller

cavity_width.rule: Width under the lips: Rexroth's figure. Unbranded stock differs from seller to seller: measure yours
cavity_width.source: slot-10-bosch rule set (Bosch Rexroth MGE 14.0, page 2-23): the slot B-type stock is sold to match; not printed by an unbranded seller

cavity_depth.rule: From the face to the floor: Rexroth's figure for its 40 mm and 45 mm heavy sections. Unbranded stock differs from seller to seller: measure yours
cavity_depth.source: slot-10-bosch rule set (Bosch Rexroth MGE 14.0, page 2-23): the slot B-type stock is sold to match; not printed by an unbranded seller

floor_width.rule: Width of the flat floor: as slot-10-bosch, itself scaled off Rexroth's drawing. Unbranded stock differs from seller to seller: measure yours
floor_width.source: slot-10-bosch rule set (Bosch Rexroth MGE 14.0, page 2-23): the slot B-type stock is sold to match; not printed by an unbranded seller

flank_angle.rule: The flanks close in at 45 degrees, as slot-10-bosch
flank_angle.source: slot-10-bosch rule set (Bosch Rexroth MGE 14.0, page 2-23): the slot B-type stock is sold to match; not printed by an unbranded seller
